📖 How to use

  1. Set your nightly sleep target in hours.
  2. Enter hours slept for each of the last 7 days.
  3. Press Calculate debt.
  4. Follow the suggested extra-sleep recovery plan.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is sleep debt?

The gap between the sleep you need and the sleep you got, summed over days. One short night creates a small debt; a week of them compounds.

How do I repay sleep debt?

Add up to 1 extra hour per night and keep a consistent bedtime — this tool builds that catch-up plan for you.

How much sleep do I need?

Most adults need 7–9 hours. This tool defaults to 8 — adjust it to what leaves you feeling rested.

Do naps count?

Naps under 30 minutes and weekend lie-ins help a little, but consistent nightly sleep repays debt best.
